_comment: Hand-written edge cases that a block scan will not reliably produce. Kept apart from fixtures/manifest.json so re-running scripts/harvest.ts can never clobber them.

entries.note: The runtime's `Log truncated` marker is present, so the panic message that would have followed is gone. Truncation must be reported, and lines after the marker must not be attributed to an instruction.
Addresses loaded from a lookup table are missing from the response. Ingest reports the gap instead of reading the table's current contents, which may have been extended since this slot.

CPI depth was never recorded for this transaction, so the two inner instructions are listed flat under instruction 0 and the node is flagged. Phase 3's CPI-progress bounding must not treat the fallback as real depth.
A variant no parser version has seen. It reaches the output with its raw value retained rather than throwing, because new runtime variants ship independently of this code.
The leanest tier that must still answer: error kind and failing instruction index, with the absence of logs stated rather than glossed over.

entries.case: failure owned by no single instruction
entries.note: A transaction-level error. The summary must not name a failing instruction, because none is responsible.
